name: react-dataflow-animator-monorepo
description: Monorepo of @dataflow-animator/core, its framework bindings (@dataflow-animator/react, @dataflow-animator/element, @dataflow-animator/angular) and their Docusaurus site.

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:lib: npm run build -w @dataflow-animator/core && npm run build -w @dataflow-animator/react && npm run build -w @dataflow-animator/element && npm run build -w @dataflow-animator/angular
